seoTitle: Create a Landing Page and Set It as Homepage in Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn how to build a new landing page in Squarespace, design it with a bold message and calls to action, and set it as your site's homepage.
intro: A dedicated landing page can help you focus visitor attention on a launch, offer, or campaign, and Squarespace makes it simple to set one as your homepage. This guide covers creating the page, designing it, and switching your homepage to point to it.

steps.heading: Create a new page
steps.body: In your Squarespace dashboard, go to Pages and add a new Blank Page or Cover Page for your landing page.

steps.heading: Name the page
steps.body: Give it a clear name that reflects its purpose, such as a campaign or launch title.

steps.heading: Design the page content
steps.body: Add a bold heading, a short message, your logo, and any relevant links or forms to match your goal for the page.

steps.heading: Style it to match your brand
steps.body: Use page sections and style settings to keep the landing page consistent with the rest of your site's branding.

steps.heading: Open the page settings
steps.body: Hover over the new page and click the settings icon to access its configuration options.

steps.heading: Set it as your homepage
steps.body: Enable the Set as Homepage option and save, so visitors land on this page by default.

faq.question: Can I set any page as my Squarespace homepage?
faq.answer: Yes, from the page settings you can enable Set as Homepage to make any page your site's default landing view.

faq.question: What's the difference between a Blank Page and a Cover Page?
faq.answer: A Cover Page is a simplified, single-scroll layout often used for landing pages, while a Blank Page gives you the full standard page editor.

faq.question: Can I add a form to my landing page?
faq.answer: Yes, you can include forms, links, or other blocks on your landing page depending on your goal.

faq.question: Will changing my homepage affect other pages?
faq.answer: No, other pages remain accessible through navigation, but visitors will land on the new homepage by default.

faq.question: Can I switch my homepage back later?
faq.answer: Yes, you can change the Set as Homepage setting again at any time to point to a different page.
